chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

When you lease land for gold or silver, do not sub-lease it for more than what you leased it for; and if you leased it for half or a third of the produce, you may sub-lease it for more than what you leased it for, because gold and silver are guaranteed (liable for loss).
ai.seo_question: What is the difference in sub-leasing rules for land leased with money versus land leased with a share of produce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'ضمان' (guarantee/liability) in lease contracts, distinguishing between fixed monetary rents where the lessee bears the risk of loss (thus capping sub-lease rates) and share-based rents where the produce is not guaranteed, allowing for higher sub--lease shares. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on risk allocation in commercial transactions, ensuring that the lessee does not profit unfairly from a guaranteed liability. This ruling is foundational in Usul al-Fiqh for understanding conditional sub-leasing (iqṭāʿ bi-l-ziyāda) in Islamic property law.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you lease a land with gold or silver, so do not sub-lease it out with more than what you had leased it with, and if you were to sub-lease it for the half (of the produce) and the third, so for you would be that you sub-lease it out for more than what you had leased it for, because the gold and the silver are both guaranteed’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

If you lease a piece of land in exchange for gold or silver, then do not lease it to someone else for more than what you have leased; but if you lease it in exchange for one-half or one-third of the produce you can lease it to someone else for more, because gold and silver are guaranteed.’”
